FTDREPLAY/FTDSTATS-2026-09-29 (owner: "backtest the first td into the ledger" -> "stop trying to predict based on price"): 🚨 Opening Drive replayed on the same ten slates with nfl_ftd.pick_stats -- one man a slate, the highest first-TD chance from nflverse football alone (usage, red-zone share, TD rate, position, home, offence vs defence TDs/EPA/opening-drive TDs; fit 2019-2025), graded on each game's first touchdown.
